class_heading: decision class (diagnostic, overlapping; amounts in margin dollars per world)

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: the periods_lost part of the failed period and every period after it
classes.label: an action the environment could not parse ended the episode

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: that period's periods_lost part
classes.label: a period never played because the episode had ended

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: that period's periods_lost part
classes.label: an award rejected because its expected kits fell below the period's minimum service

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: the period's periods_lost part when the award was rejected, else its service part
classes.label: an award placed on a day when one of its lines could no longer arrive by the deadline

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: that period's periods_lost part
classes.label: an award rejected for a supplier with no verified sample

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: that period's periods_lost part
classes.label: an award rejected for ordering above a supplier's capacity

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: minus quantity times (awarded price minus the floor at that standing), summed over the award's lines
classes.label: a feasible award priced above the supplier's floor on at least one line

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: minus the counter's cost
classes.label: a counter-offer the supplier refused

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign (positive): quantity times the discount below list, summed over the award's lines
classes.label: a feasible award priced under a loyalty discount (a gain, not a failure)

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: minus quantity times the markup above list, summed over the award's lines
classes.label: a feasible award priced under a retaliation markup from a supplier quoted and dropped the period before

classes.amount_basis: none: counted, not priced here; its price shows in the loyalty and retaliation classes
classes.label: a feasible award whose supplier set differs from the previous feasible award's (as the family counts switches)

classes.amount_basis: USD, margin sign: minus the inquiry fee
classes.label: a verbal inquiry: it never authorizes an award
